create_disjoint_bandit_container: create a DisjointBanditContainer with per-arm bandit models and an exploration module for discrete action spaces
learn_batch_disjoint_bandit: learn from a TransitionBatch by partitioning observations per arm and updating each arm bandit model
act_disjoint_bandit: select an action using ensemble forward pass across arm models and the exploration module
get_scores_disjoint_bandit: get UCB or exploration scores for each arm given a subjective state and action space
compare_disjoint_bandit: compare two DisjointBanditContainer instances and return a string describing differences in arms and attributes
